platform: FamilyFlix By DemureGram — Developer Catalog & Playback Architecture Blueprint

architectureNotesForDeveloper.database: PostgreSQL (tables: movies, movie_genres, genres, media_rights, video_assets, imported_movie_sources, imported_torrent_sources, series_seasons, series_episodes, subtitles)
architectureNotesForDeveloper.inMemoryCatalogCache: artifacts/api-server/src/lib/catalog-service.ts pre-loads all 23,272 titles into memory on server boot with O(1) Map lookups by ID/slug and pre-computed homepage curated rows (<10ms API response).

playbackPipeline.directArchiveMp4AndHls: Movies and TV episodes with a ready row in video_assets serve direct HTTPS MP4/HLS streams (e.g., Archive.org / CDN MP4 URLs).
playbackPipeline.webTorrentHttpRangeGateway: Titles backed by imported_torrent_sources stream via GET /api/playback/:slug/media (artifacts/api-server/src/lib/torrent-playback.ts), which resolves the .torrent metadata, prioritizes initial & tail MP4 header pieces via 2-argument torrent.critical(start, end), and pipes byte-range responses (HTTP 206 Partial Content) directly to the HTML5 <video> player.
playbackPipeline.tvSeriesPlayback: TV series store seasons in series_seasons and episodes in series_episodes. GET /api/playback/:slug automatically resolves episode 1 for series-level playback, while GET /api/playback/:slug/episodes/:episodeId resolves individual episode streams.
